Coppock, Alexander. 2026. <b>conjointmatchups: Reshape and Extract Matchups from Forced-Choice Conjoint Experiments</b>. R package version 0.0.0.9000.

# Abstract
Infrastructure for the data grammar of forced-choice (paired) conjoint experiments. Provides lossless reshaping between the profile-level (long, one row per candidate profile) and task-level (wide, one row per choice task) representations, and extraction of "matchups": the subset of tasks realizing a specified contrast between the two profiles, returned with a clean binary outcome ready for estimation. Complements single-experiment estimators such as cregg, cjoint, projoint, and factorEx by producing the analysis-ready datasets they consume, and underlies the Average Feature Choice Probability (AFCP) estimand of Abramson, Kocak, Magazinnik, and Strezhnev.
